name: MementoMC
description:
MementoMC is a Hardcore server where if you die, you're banned forever. This is your one life. No resets, no respawns and no second chances.

Every cave you enter, every player you trust and every fight you take could be your last. Make friends, make enemies, build your base and do whatever it takes to survive. Every decision matters because one mistake could be your last.

When you die, a gravestone marks the place where your story ended, displaying your player head, cause of death and date of death. Friends can visit your grave to honor your memory, or the player who killed you can claim your head as a trophy.

Good luck, have fun and most importantly: don't die!
